senses.gloss: (= בית הבחירה, I Chr. XXIX, 1; 19) the chosen Divine residence, Temple.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 119a:8">Zeb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>והא בעי ב׳</he> does it not require a chosen residence (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 12:18">Deut. XII, 18</cite>)? Y. Pes. II, 35ᵃ top <he>כל הר וכ׳</he> the whole Temple mount is named Birah; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite>.
